{{Quote|A death-mask from Langoona! And you call ''this'' a fitting gift?|[[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]], to [[Durga Besadii Tai]]|<ref name="RD" />}}
'''Langoona''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] ago, it was the homeworld of a [[Langoonan|once-favored]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. However, after a [[Langoonan rebellion|failed rebellion]], their masters drove them to the brink of extinction, preserving them only as targets for [[Hunting/Legends|sadistic safaris]].

==Description==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> was located in a [[Langoona system/Legends|star system]] of the same name<ref name="EAOC" /> deep within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Bootana Hutta/Legends|very heart]] of the region.<ref name="LH" /> Langoona was the homeworld of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Langoonan]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> The natives, who lived on islands, carved [[Langoonan deathmask|death-masks]] that they decorated with semiprecious [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] and inlays of [[Silver/Legends|silver]], [[Gold/Legends|gold]], [[Platinum/Legends|platinum]], and iridescent shell-casings from their warm [[Water/Legends|seas]].<ref name="RD" />

==History==
Langoona was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Langoonan]]s. Their world fell under the growing influence of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] no later than the time of the [[Xim Wars]]. The Langoonans were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt Empire]] and gradually became a favored slave species.<ref name="TEA" /> Langoona became part of the subsectors of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], known as the [[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Garden]]. It was a center of concentration for the most influential [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]], where they stored their wealth and directed their criminal empires and clan operations. The entire region and its [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] were well protected by starship patrols, and non-Hutt outsiders were rarely allowed into the area, aside from the ever-present Hutt slaves and indentured servants.<ref name="LH" />

[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] ago, before the [[Declaration of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the natives of Langoona had [[Langoonan rebellion|rebelled]] against the Hutts. Nevertheless, they had failed, and their cruel masters had forced them to pay a horrible price. The Langoonans were stripped of all technology and driven to the edge of extinction; they were preserved as the objects of sadistic Hutt safaris, with their population carefully maintained to ensure good hunts.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Langoona was first appeared in the novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', published in [[1998]], although no information about the planet itself was provided.<ref name="RD" /> More information about it was later presented in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
